prediction_unit: Expected aggregate incident count for one tenant, H3 cell, category, and six-hour UTC window.

primary_metric.name: poisson_deviance
primary_metric.definition: Mean Poisson deviance on the untouched chronological test window; lower is better.

intended_uses: Aggregate area-level planning and model evaluation with human interpretation.
prohibited_uses: Individual criminality assessment, suspect identification, or automated enforcement decisions.
limitations: Forecasts may reproduce reporting and enforcement patterns present in historical data.
uncertainty_method: Prediction intervals are computed deterministically from held-out residual behavior and documented with the run.
suppression_policy: Cells and windows below the configured aggregate support threshold are marked suppressed and expose no numeric value to Reka.
feature_interpretation: Drivers describe model associations and must never be described as causes.
